description: OMENZ Transaction Guard: ONE call before money moves. 'PAY $X TO Y FOR Z' -> GO / CAUTION / STOP with every check: budget authorized (Shared Budget), counterparty checked (Authorize: live 402, payTo, known seller, OFAC sanctions screen, fair price + Seller Track Record), DUPLICATE PAYMENT checked (OMENZ records and your on-chain USDC history to that payee, Base), quoted price unchanged, settlement economics, expected delivery recorded (seller's advertised output fingerprint). Then checkout/close: settled -> delivery verified -> signed receipt -> reconciled. Send url (or q), payer (your wallet), quoted_price_usd, purpose, budget_id. Larger purchases: guard/credit at 10 bps of the protected value (min $0.01, max $5). Never touches your money. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/guard, $0.05 via x402.)

expected_pay_to.description: payout wallet you expect (0x...), to catch swapped payees

max_price_usd.description: most you are willing to pay per call, in USD

method.description: HTTP method of the target endpoint (GET or POST)
